releases.name: Streets of New York
releases.summary:
New York City, 1981. As night falls, the streets transform into a battleground where gangs fight for respect, survival, and dominance. 

In Streets of New York, you are part of a tight-knit gang with one mission: make it through hostile territory and return to your home turf. Inspired by the raw intensity of The Warriors, this game plunges you into a relentless journey across New York’s gritty, neon-lit boroughs, where danger lurks around every corner.

Each gang you encounter has its own identity, rules, and reputation. Some might let you pass with a bribe or favor, while others seek only violence. As you navigate the city, you’ll face intense confrontations and challenging alliances, where every decision counts. Fights are brutal, fast, and unpredictable, pushing you to work together with your crew or go solo if necessary.

From navigating labyrinthine subway stations to cutting through abandoned buildings and dark alleyways, Streets of New York captures the intense, claustrophobic feel of a city at night where you’re never truly safe.

releases.name: VALDIS
releases.summary: VALDIS is a thrilling blend of third-person shooter and tower defense. Protect the Laboratory Core from waves of mutants, place turrets, build barriers, and uncover the tragic story behind twisted experiments. The battle for freedom begins!

releases.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
releases.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

releases.name: I'm Prisoner VR: Prison Escape
releases.summary: You and your crew are trapped in a maximum-security prison. Work together to crack passwords, avoid cameras, disable alarms, and unlock the path to freedom.

releases.name: Grave Of Voices
releases.summary: Ryan Morgan, a 21-year-old horror vlogger, thought he had found the perfect lead for his next video. But when he enters Ashfall, a town erased from the map, he realizes he's trapped in the catacombs below. To escape, he must solve puzzles, scavenge, hide from inhuman creatures, and fight to survive.

releases.name: Nightborn
releases.summary:
Investigate a series of disappearances of your fellow Vampires, including your Maker, a politically influential member of the Nightborn, the Vampire elite of New Orleans. Players assume the role of the Bloodhound, a Vampire detective trained in tracking supernatural threats to the Nightborn, using arcane rituals forbidden to others of your kind.

Create your own Bloodhound character, choosing from 10 iconic Vampire lineages with a set of signature lineage power skill trees. Lineage powers include physical prowess enhancements, shapeshifting, controlling the minds of mortals, and acts of eldritch sorcery.

Solve the mysteries of gothic New Orleans by taking quests, discovering clues, and exploring the supernatural underworld.

Battle, evade, or outwit, natural and supernatural foes, using your powers, weapons, and tactics.

releases.name: Asphalt Outlaws Car Racing Game
releases.summary:
Get ready to hit the road in Asphalt Outlaws Car Racing Game, where speed, skill, and adrenaline come together for an exciting racing experience!

Take control of powerful sports cars, race through stunning urban environments, and push your driving skills to the limit. Every race is a chance to prove yourself, master the road, and leave your rivals behind.
